oneLine: Valmiki Leela Capital targets ₹3,000 crore IPO pipeline.

sources.title: Valmiki Leela Capital Targets ₹3,000 Crore IPO Pipeline

synopsis: Merchant banker Valmiki Leela Capital is planning a new IPO pipeline worth ₹3,000 crore to be executed over the next 12 to 18 months, with a focus on renewable energy and manufacturing sectors. This follows the successful launch of the ₹460-crore mainboard initial public offering for Deepa Jewellers, which was also handled by Valmiki Leela Capital. The firm's pivot toward larger public market deals aims to help mid-market companies raise equity capital, though the execution of these targets remains subject to market volatility and regulatory approvals.
